text: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Brisbane?

result.keyword: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Brisbane?

items.markdown:
Brisbane's top luxury real estate agencies include `Place Estate Agents (notably Sarah Hackett and Drew Davies), Ray White Collective (led by Matt Lancashire and Haesley Cush), and Adcock Prestige` . Leading elite auctioneers for high-value properties feature multi-award winners like Haesley Cush and Gavin Croft of Ray White.[[1]](https://www.eplace.com.au/brisbanes-luxury-agent)[[2]](https://theresearcher.com.au/best-real-estate-agents-brisbane/)[[3]](https://www.raywhite.com/haesley-cush/real-estate-agent/haesley.cush/)[[4]](https://adcockprestige.com/about/)[[5]](https://www.raywhite.com/brisbane100/auctioneers)

### Leading Luxury Agencies

- **Place Estate Agents (New Farm / Bulimba):** Dominates the high-end inner-city residential and riverfront market, with elite agents like Sarah Hackett setting record price-per-square-metre benchmarks.[[1]](https://www.eplace.com.au/brisbanes-luxury-agent)
- **Ray White Collective (New Farm / Ascot / Bulimba):** A powerhouse group handling a massive share of Brisbane's premier multi-million-dollar transactions, driven by top luxury performers and extensive buyer networks.[[1]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agent/haesley-cush-1481082)
- **Adcock Prestige:** A specialized boutique agency founded by Jason Adcock , dedicated entirely to luxury estates, heritage properties, and architectural showpieces across Brisbane.[[1]](https://adcockprestige.com/about/)
- **Queensland Sotheby's International Realty:** Connects prestige Brisbane addresses to a powerful global luxury network for high-net-worth international buyers.

### Top-Performing Auctioneers

- **Haesley Cush (Ray White Collective):** A multi-award-winning auctioneer who has called over 10,000 auctions and holds a record for winning the REIQ Auctioneer of the Year title every time he has entered.
- **Gavin Croft (Ray White Queensland):** Chief Auctioneer with decades of experience, recognized as a premier REIQ Auctioneer of the Year and trusted with high-stakes prestige sales.
- **Mitch Peereboom (Ray White):** Renowned high-volume and high-intensity auctioneer with thousands of successful property calls across Brisbane's competitive markets.[[1]](https://www.raywhite.com/brisbane100/auctioneers)[[2]](https://www.raywhite.com/haesley-cush/real-estate-agent/haesley.cush/)[[3]](https://www.raywhite.com/people/haesley-cush)
